AudioFlipper and RDPLauncher are now **Taskbar Widgets**, with a third widget, **Taskbar Snipper**. The apps are built from the Windhawk mods now, so each app and its mod are the same code.

| App | Widget | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AudioFlipper.exe` | Taskbar Audio Flipper: switch speakers, headsets and microphones with a click, and turn a webcam on and off | 1.1.0 |
| `RDPLauncher.exe` | Taskbar RDP Launcher: Remote Desktop full screen on the number of displays you pick | 1.1.0 |
| `TaskbarSnipper.exe` | Taskbar Snipper: Print Screen to select, mark up and copy or save; Win+Shift+R to record, trim and copy or save | 1.0.0, new |

There's nothing to install: run one, and its widget appears on the taskbar. Its icon in the notification area has **Settings…** (Taskbar Snipper), **Start with Windows** and **Exit**.

## New

- **Taskbar Snipper**, for screenshots marked up with a pencil, lines, arrows, boxes and text, and screen recordings trimmed at the start and end.
- **All three link** into one widget: right-click any of them, open **Link widgets**, and choose **Link with** another. **Move this widget left** and **right** put them in order.
- **Fluent icons** in Taskbar Audio Flipper, in the taskbar's color, by default. **Icon style** in its menu switches back to the devices' Windows icons.
- The apps are native 64-bit, about 1 MB each, and don't need .NET.

## Moving from AudioFlipper 1.4 or RDPLauncher 1.1

Exit the old app, then run the new one. It takes on the old app's settings the first time it runs, and **Start with Windows** in its menu takes the old app's place at startup. Run the app or the Windhawk mod of a widget, not both: an app won't start while its mod runs.

The Windhawk mods are attached too, and in [mods](https://github.com/Lucidic15/TaskbarWidgets/tree/main/mods).
